results.reason: dream was fading(사라져가는), line became tense(팽팽한), eyes widened(커진) = ②
pulled out(당겨꺼냄), cast(던짐), wildly(격렬하게) = ③
deep sigh(한숨), excitedly(신나서), beat faster(뛰다) = ①
④ reluctantly → 원문 excitedly. 흥분해서 잡은 것이지 마지못해가 아님

The ___ was known for fishing spots on the lake → shoreline(해안선)
dream was ___ → fading(사라져가는). 꿈이 시들어감
line suddenly became ___ → tense(팽팽한). became 뒤 형용사
spots = places(장소). fishing spots = 낚시 장소
cast = threw(던지다). cast it back into the water
tense = tight(팽팽한). 낚싯줄이 팽팽해짐
fading(사라져가는) 반의어 = growing(커져가는)
wildly(격렬하게) 반의어 = calmly(차분하게)
(A) fishing line = 줄/끈, (B) stand in line = 줄/열 → ②
long deep breath when sad/tired/disappointed = sigh(한숨)
excite → excitedly(부사). 동사 held 수식
excite → excitement(명사). with + 명사
about to ___ and leave → give up(포기하다)
heart began to ___ with excitement → beat faster
